data.completion_memo: Implemented the shared M12 anchored native filesystem layer with stable handle/object identity, per-operation identity revalidation, canonical relative paths, symlink/reparse and case-alias denial, mount/volume containment, current-owner/access checks, local-volume capability reporting, advisory writer guards, bounded reads, same-directory durable create/expected-content replace, same-volume whole-directory publication, and explicit degraded/read-only behavior when guarantees cannot be proven. Portable-store now exposes native capability facts, gates durable writes, and retains read-only Git inspection only. Bootstrap-helper now has native immutable whole-build slot materialization/publication with sealed permissions and anchored revalidation plus a durable journal-fenced selector that observes, switches, restores, reopens, and reconciles exact outcomes without blind replay. Managed publication remains unavailable unless all OS-specific durability/ownership/volume guarantees pass; package-owned activation and Git writes remain absent. Verification passed with warnings denied across aworkit-process, portable-store, and bootstrap-helper (73 tests including new native path, slot, selector, alias, durability, and idempotency cases).
data.description: Implement the shared filesystem/durability platform ports on Windows, macOS, and Linux: anchored path and object identity, traversal/symlink/reparse/mount containment, atomic file and directory publication, durable sync, ownership/mode checks, local-volume proof, portable workspace operations, build-slot publication, and managed-local selector observe/switch/restore. Keep Git writes and unsupported package-owned activation paths disabled.
data.title: M12.1 — Implement native filesystem, durability, and selector adapters
